versos.grego: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀξίως περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε,

controles.web: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
controles.kjv: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
controles.livre: Portanto, eu, o prisioneiro no Senhor, rogo-vos que andeis como é digno do chamado com que fostes chamados,

versos.grego: μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ πραΰτητος, μετὰ μακροθυμίας, ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων ἐν ἀγάπῃ,

controles.web: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;
controles.kjv: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
controles.livre: com toda humildade e mansidão; com paciência, tolerando uns aos outros em amor.

versos.grego: σπουδάζοντες τηρεῖν τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐν τῷ συνδέσμῳ τῆς εἰρήνης·

controles.web: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
controles.kjv: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
controles.livre: Procurai guardar a unidade do Espírito pelo vínculo da paz.

versos.grego: ἓν σῶμα καὶ ἓν Πνεῦμα, καθὼς καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν μιᾷ ἐλπίδι τῆς κλήσεως ὑμῶν·

controles.web: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;
controles.kjv: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
controles.livre: Há um só corpo, e um só Espírito, como também fostes chamados em uma só esperança do vosso chamado.

versos.grego: εἷς Κύριος, μία πίστις, ἓν βάπτισμα·

controles.web: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
controles.kjv: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
controles.livre: Um só Senhor, uma só fé, um só batismo;

versos.grego: εἷς Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.
controles.kjv: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
controles.livre: um só Deus, e Pai de todos, que é acima de todos, por meio de todos, e em todos.

versos.grego: Ἑνὶ δὲ ἑκάστῳ ἡμῶν ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς δωρεᾶς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
controles.kjv: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
controles.livre: Mas a graça foi dada a cada um de nós conforme a medida do dom de Cristo.

versos.grego: διὸ λέγει Ἀναβὰς εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσεν αἰχμαλωσίαν, ἔδωκεν δόματα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.”
controles.kjv: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
controles.livre: Por isso diz: Quando ele subiu ao alto, levou cativo o cativeiro,  e deu dons às pessoas.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ Ἀνέβη τί ἐστιν εἰ μὴ ὅτι καὶ κατέβη εἰς τὰ κατώτερα μέρη τῆς γῆς;

controles.web: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
controles.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
controles.livre: (O que significa este “ele subiu”, senão que ele também tinha descido às partes mais baixas da terra?)

versos.grego: ὁ καταβὰς αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἀναβὰς ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἵνα πληρώσῃ τὰ πάντα.

controles.web: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
controles.kjv: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
controles.livre: Aquele que desceu é também o mesmo que subiu muito acima de todos os céus, para preencher  todas as coisas.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν τοὺς μὲν ἀποστόλους, τοὺς δὲ προφήτας, τοὺς δὲ εὐαγγελιστάς, τοὺς δὲ ποιμένας καὶ διδασκάλους,

controles.web: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
controles.kjv: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
controles.livre: E ele mesmo deu uns como apóstolos, outros como profetas outros como evangelistas, e outros como pastores e instrutores.

versos.grego: πρὸς τὸν καταρτισμὸν τῶν ἁγίων εἰς ἔργον διακονίας, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;
controles.kjv: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
controles.livre: para o aperfeiçoamento dos santos, para a obra do serviço,  para a edificação do corpo de Cristo;

versos.grego: μέχρι καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ, εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον, εἰς μέτρον ἡλικίας τοῦ πληρώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;
controles.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
controles.livre: até que todos cheguemos à unidade da fé e do conhecimento do Filho de Deus, à maturidade,  à medida da estatura da plenitude de Cristo.

versos.grego: ἵνα μηκέτι ὦμεν νήπιοι, κλυδωνιζόμενοι καὶ περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἐν τῇ κυβίᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν πανουργίᾳ πρὸς τὴν μεθοδίαν τῆς πλάνης,

controles.web: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
controles.kjv: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
controles.livre: O fim disso é que não mais sejamos crianças inconstantes, levadas de um lado para outro por todo vento de doutrina, pelo engano dos pessoas que, para enganar, usam de fraudes com astúcia.

versos.grego: ἀληθεύοντες δὲ ἐν ἀγάπῃ αὐξήσωμεν εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλή, Χριστός,

controles.web: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;
controles.kjv: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
controles.livre: Pelo contrário, sigamos a verdade em amor, e cresçamos em tudo naquele que é a cabeça: Cristo.

versos.grego: ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα συναρμολογούμενον καὶ συνβιβαζόμενον διὰ πάσης ἁφῆς τῆς ἐπιχορηγίας κατ’ ἐνέργειαν ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου μέρους τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ.

controles.web: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
controles.kjv: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
controles.livre: É dele que todo o corpo, bem ajustado e unido por todos os ligamentos, conforme a operação de cada parte na medida devida, proporciona o crescimento do corpo, para a sua própria edificação em amor.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο οὖν λέγω καὶ μαρτύρομαι ἐν Κυρίῳ, μηκέτι ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καθὼς καὶ τὰ ἔθνη περιπατεῖ ἐν ματαιότητι τοῦ νοὸς αὐτῶν,

controles.web: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
controles.kjv: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
controles.livre: Portanto digo isso, e dou testemunho no Senhor, que não andeis mais como os gentios andam, na futilidade das suas mentes.

versos.grego: ἐσκοτωμένοι τῇ διανοίᾳ ὄντες, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ, διὰ τὴν ἄγνοιαν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν αὐτοῖς, διὰ τὴν πώρωσιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν,

controles.web: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;
controles.kjv: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
controles.livre: Esses têm o entendimento nas trevas, e estão separados da vida de Deus pela ignorância que há neles, pela dureza do seu coração.

versos.grego: οἵτινες ἀπηλγηκότες ἑαυτοὺς παρέδωκαν τῇ ἀσελγείᾳ εἰς ἐργασίαν ἀκαθαρσίας πάσης ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ.

controles.web: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
controles.kjv: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
controles.livre: Como se tornaram insensíveis, eles se entregaram à sensualidade, para cometerem com avidez toda impureza.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐμάθετε τὸν Χριστόν,

controles.web: But you did not learn Christ that way;
controles.kjv: But ye have not so learned Christ;
controles.livre: Mas não foi assim que vós aprendestes de Cristo;

versos.grego: εἴ γε αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε, καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
controles.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
controles.livre: se é que o ouvistes, e fostes ensinados nele, como a verdade está em Jesus;

versos.grego: ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης,

controles.web: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;
controles.kjv: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
controles.livre: quanto ao comportamento passado, que deveis abandonar o velho ser humano, que se corrompe pelos maus desejos de engano;

versos.grego: ἀνανεοῦσθαι δὲ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν,

controles.web: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
controles.kjv: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
controles.livre: que deveis vos renovar no espírito da vossa mente;

versos.grego: καὶ ἐνδύσασθαι τὸν καινὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κατὰ Θεὸν κτισθέντα ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ὁσιότητι τῆς ἀληθείας.

controles.web: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
controles.kjv: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
controles.livre: e que deveis vos revestir do novo ser humano, que é criado conforme Deus na verdadeira justiça e santidade.

versos.grego: Διὸ ἀποθέμενοι τὸ ψεῦδος λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσμὲν ἀλλήλων μέλη.

controles.web: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
controles.kjv: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
controles.livre: Portanto, abandonai a mentira, e falai a verdade cada um ao seu próximo; pois somos membros uns dos outros.

versos.grego: ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε· ὁ ἥλιος μὴ ἐπιδυέτω ἐπὶ παροργισμῷ ὑμῶν,

controles.web: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
controles.kjv: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
controles.livre: Quando irardes, não pequeis;  o sol não se ponha sobre a vossa ira;

versos.grego: μηδὲ δίδοτε τόπον τῷ διαβόλῳ.

controles.web: neither give place to the devil.
controles.kjv: Neither give place to the devil.
controles.livre: nem deis lugar ao diabo.

versos.grego: ὁ κλέπτων μηκέτι κλεπτέτω, μᾶλλον δὲ κοπιάτω ἐργαζόμενος ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἵνα ἔχῃ μεταδιδόναι τῷ χρείαν ἔχοντι.

controles.web: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
controles.kjv: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
controles.livre: O que furtava, não furte mais; em vez disso, trabalhe, operando com as próprias mãos o bem, para que tenha o que repartir com o que tiver necessidade.

versos.grego: πᾶς λόγος σαπρὸς ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν μὴ ἐκπορευέσθω, ἀλλὰ εἴ τις ἀγαθὸς πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας, ἵνα δῷ χάριν τοῖς ἀκούουσιν.

controles.web: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
controles.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
controles.livre: Não saia de vossa boca palavra imoral; mas sim a boa para a edificação conforme a necessidade; para que comunique graça aos que a ouvem.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ λυπεῖτε τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἐν ᾧ ἐσφραγίσθητε εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπολυτρώσεως.

controles.web: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
controles.kjv: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
controles.livre: E não entristeçais o Espírito Santo de Deus, no qual fostes selados para o dia da libertação.

versos.grego: πᾶσα πικρία καὶ θυμὸς καὶ ὀργὴ καὶ κραυγὴ καὶ βλασφημία ἀρθήτω ἀφ’ ὑμῶν σὺν πάσῃ κακίᾳ.

controles.web: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.
controles.kjv: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
controles.livre: Toda amargura, raiva, ira, gritaria, e maledicência sejam tiradas do meio de vós, assim como toda malícia.

versos.grego: γίνεσθε δὲ εἰς ἀλλήλους χρηστοί, εὔσπλαγχνοι, χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν.

controles.web: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
controles.kjv: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
controles.livre: Em vez disso, sede benignos uns com os outros, misericordiosos, perdoando-vos uns aos outros, como também Deus vos perdoou em Cristo.
